dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interlocking and discrete O-shaped high-intensity perimeters on a low-intensity field. Perimeters are thin with a sharp contrast gradient transitioning from light-colored edges to dark-colored interiors. Prominent structures include an elongated oval in the upper mid-section and several smaller, irregular circles towards the posterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, interspersed between larger annuli, particularly visible in the mid-lateral and anterior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest edge roughly parallel to the animal's spinal alignment.
